packageRules.description: Automerge minor and patch updates on green PRs

Don't let Renovate bump the monorepo's own @happyvertical/smrt-* packages where the starter templates pin them as real npmjs deps for downstream projects. Those pins are synced to the monorepo release at publish time (scripts/sync-template-versions.mjs); chasing them against npmjs only produces self-referential, perpetually-stale PRs (#1698/#1699/#1700).
